name: Heiress II
source:
Finding himself at a gala charity evening on a luxury airship, Mikhail is part of a "date auction". Surprisingly, the highest bidder for him is the richest woman on board, Cen Isyanina.

[From [url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]Official site[/url]]
translation:
米哈伊尔参加了一场豪华飞艇上的慈善晚宴，并成为“约会拍卖”的拍品。出人意料的是，船上最富有的女子森·伊夏尼娜为他给出了最高报价。

[摘自[url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]官方网站[/url]]
